subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about win-back for lapsed paid subscribers. Antenna's latest read shows ad-supported tiers now drive 57% of gross adds on premium SVOD, with monthly churn parked around 5%, so the cheaper entry plan that wins a subscriber is also the one easiest to leave and re-enter. For subscription apps, CPAs run roughly $29 to $63, exactly the band where paywall-leak cohorting and a holdout control decide your real cost per recovered subscriber. Worth comparing that against how Paramount+ and Max are timing their win-back pressure?
angle: fresh angle: ad-tier 57% of SVOD gross adds (Antenna, sourced) + subscription-app CPA band $29-63
